member.name: T:Rokka.Common.ConsistentHashRing
member.summary: High-performance, thread-safe consistent hash ring implementation.
member.remarks: This class utilizes virtual nodes to distribute keys uniformly across physical servers. Read operations (e.g., routing a page ID) use a volatile read of the pre-sorted ring array and a binary search to achieve O(log(N*V)) lookups with lock-free reads. Write operations (adding or removing nodes) are coordinated via a monitor lock and trigger atomic array swaps.
